name: How do I choose between a steel beam and a wood beam for my project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a steel beam and a wood beam for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a steel and wood beam depends on several project-specific factors. Steel beams are ideal for supporting very heavy loads and achieving longer clear spans, making them suitable for large open-concept designs or commercial applications. They offer superior strength-to-weight ratio. Wood beams, including engineered wood products like LVL or Glulam, are generally more cost-effective, lighter, and easier to work with for typical residential renovations. The final decision should be made in consultation with a structural engineer, who will consider load requirements, span, aesthetics, budget, and local building codes to recommend the most appropriate material.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose steel for heavy loads and long spans, or wood for cost-effectiveness and typical residential use; an engineer will make the final material recommendation.
